title: BY HOW MUCH DO BATTERIES CUT CURTAILMENT
subtitle: Days with more charging see more curtailment, even with solar and the month held fixed
source: Source: CAISO production and curtailment report; CAISO Today's Outlook (storage, fuel source); ERW tables caiso_curtailment_daily, caiso_battery_storage, caiso_fuel_supply.
unit: MWh curtailed per GWh charged (charging, solar output and month held fixed)
sentence: Each extra GWh a day of charging goes with 1,081 MWh more curtailment, solar output and the month held fixed (standard error 172, p 0.000).
